company_overview: Postman is an AI-native API platform that enables teams to develop, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services. It provides high productivity for developers, ensures API quality, and enforces airtight governance for organizations at enterprise scale.
target_audience: Developers, engineering teams, product teams, and enterprises (including 98% of the Fortune 500). It serves various industries such as Financial Services, E-Commerce, Data Analytics, and DevOps to streamline the API lifecycle and collaboration.

company_overview: Supabase is an open-source developer platform that provides a fully managed Postgres database along with essential back-end features such as authentication, storage, edge functions, and realtime data synchronization. It offers developers and organizations a scalable, integrated alternative to Firebase for building modern web and mobile applications.
target_audience: Developers, engineering teams, startups, enterprises, innovation teams, agencies, and citizen developers (including non-technical staff) seeking to build, prototype, and scale production-ready applications, with specific solutions for industries like FinServ and Healthcare.

company_overview: Vapi is a unified platform for building, deploying, and scaling voice AI agents that handle tasks such as customer support, lead qualification, and appointment scheduling. The company provides enterprise-grade infrastructure with sub-500ms latency, allowing businesses to replace human call centers with automated voice interactions that integrate with existing systems.
target_audience: Developers, engineering teams, and enterprises in industries such as healthcare, insurance, automotive, freight, and home security. The platform serves organizations ranging from small businesses to Fortune 100 companies, specifically targeting teams looking to automate contact center functions like customer support, lead generation, and appointment scheduling.
